# Definition of the immunosuppressed host
```{r clean overall table}
table_lum_CarTrans_overall <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%filter(
    !(Study_ID %in% c("CarTrans-Long-16", "CarTrans-Long-23", "CarTrans-Long-36") &
      str_detect(Visit, "^VX")))%>%
  select(-ISHLT_1990, -Class_Sup)
```

```{r prep metadata}
# Rename visits in overall table
table_lum_CarTrans_overall <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%
  mutate(
    Visit = as.character(Visit),
    Visit = case_when(
    Visit == "Healthy" ~ "Healthy",
    Visit == "V0" ~ "Baseline",
    Visit == "V1" ~ "Week 1",
    Visit == "V2" ~ "Week 2",
    Visit == "V3" ~ "Month 1-3",
    Visit == "V4" ~ "Month 4-6",
    Visit == "V5" ~ "Month 12",
    grepl("^VX", Visit) ~ Visit, #keep different X timepoints to not create duplicates
    TRUE~Visit
    ),
    Visit = factor(Visit,levels = c("Healthy","Baseline","Week 1","Week 2","Month 1-3","Month 4-6","Month 12", "VX1", "VX2", "VX3", "VX4")) 
  )

# Assign unique sample IDs for each study ID
table_lum_CarTrans_overall <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%
  mutate(Sample_ID = paste(Study_ID, Visit, sep = "_"))
```

```{r relabel timpoint}
# Create annotation table
table_lum_CarTrans_overall <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%
  mutate(Timepoint= case_when(grepl("^VX", Visit) ~ "Rejection Context",TRUE ~ Visit))

 table_lum_CarTrans_overall$Timepoint = factor(table_lum_CarTrans_overall$Timepoint,levels = c("Healthy","Baseline","Week 1","Week 2","Month 1-3","Month 4-6","Month 12", "Rejection Context")) 
```

# Set analysis for Month 1-3 vs Healthy 
```{r heatmap Healthy vs Month 1-3, fig.height=9, fig.width=14} 
# Subset for Healthy and Month 1-3
table_convalesence <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%filter(Visit %in% c("Healthy", "Month 1-3"))

# Create annotation table
list_convalesence <- table_convalesence %>%dplyr::select(Study_ID, Visit)

rownames(list_convalesence ) <- list_convalesence $Study_ID
list_convalesence  <- list_convalesence  [, c("Visit"), drop = FALSE]  

# Remove metadata columns
table_convalesence_01 <- table_convalesence  %>%
  dplyr::select(-Study_ID, -Visit)

# Convert Data Table to Data Frame
  table_convalesence_01 <- as.data.frame(table_convalesence_01)
  
# Transpose Data Table
  table_convalesence_01_t <- t(table_convalesence_01)
  
## Column Annotations
  colnames(table_convalesence_01_t) <- table_convalesence$Study_ID


## Row Annotations
  # Create list with Parameters 
    list_parameter_groups <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file.path(basedir,"data", "Grouping of Luminex Marker.xlsx"))

  # Create list with Columns of data table
    list_parameter_datatable <- as.data.frame(rownames(table_convalesence_01_t))
                                colnames(list_parameter_datatable) <- "Parameter"

  # Merge to match the order of parameters
    list_parameter_groups_01 <- merge(list_parameter_groups, list_parameter_datatable, by.y = "Parameter")

# Define the predefined order for Group
  group_order <- c("Cytokine", "Chemokine", "Growth factor/Tissue Cytokine", "Activation Marker")

# Order list based on predefined order
#  selected_markers <- c("HGF","IL2R", "CXCL9", "CXCL10", "IL6", "CCL3", "CCL4")
  
# Filter and order
  list_parameter_groups_02 <- list_parameter_groups_01 %>%
                              mutate(Grouping = factor(Grouping, levels = group_order)) %>%
                              arrange(Parameter)
  
# Extract ordered parameter vector
  list_parameter_groups_03 <- as.character(list_parameter_groups_02$Parameter)

# Reorder Data Table based on the new ordered list
  table_convalesence_01_t_ordered <- as.data.frame(table_convalesence_01_t)
  table_convalesence_01_t_ordered <- table_convalesence_01_t[list_parameter_groups_03, ]

# Convert it back to matrix
  table_convalesence_01_t_ordered<- as.matrix(table_convalesence_01_t_ordered)

#Convert back to numeric
  table_convalesence_01_t_ordered <- matrix(
    as.numeric(trimws(table_convalesence_01_t_ordered)),
    nrow = nrow(table_convalesence_01_t_ordered),
    dimnames = dimnames(table_convalesence_01_t_ordered))
  
# Log Transform 
  table_convalesence_01_t_ordered<- log2(table_convalesence_01_t_ordered)
  
# Scale 
  table_convalesence_01_t_ordered<- t(apply(table_convalesence_01_t_ordered, 1, scale))

# Create Cohort Label Colors of Annotations in heatmap
  ann_colors <- list(
    Visit = c(
      "Healthy" = "grey",
      "Month 1-3" = "#4DD0E1"),
  Grouping = c(
    "Cytokine" = "darkseagreen",
    "Chemokine" = "lightblue", 
    "Growth factor/Tissue Cytokine" = "mediumpurple3",
    "Activation Marker" =  "lightpink"))

# Column Annotation
  col_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(df = list_convalesence, col = ann_colors)

# Row Annotation
  #  Prepare row annotations as a data frame
  row_anno <- rowAnnotation(Grouping = list_parameter_groups_02$Grouping,
                            col = list(Grouping = ann_colors$Grouping))

# Create Heatmap
  heatmap_convalesence <- Heatmap(table_convalesence_01_t_ordered, 
                         name = "Expression",  
                         col = circlize::colorRamp2(c(-5, 0, 5), c("blue", "white", "red")),  
                         cluster_rows = TRUE,  
                         cluster_columns = TRUE,  
                              ,  
                         show_column_names = TRUE,  
                         column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),  
                         row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),  
                         width = unit(18, "cm"), height = unit(15, "cm"),  
                         top_annotation = col_anno,
                         right_annotation = row_anno)

# Draw Heatmap
  show(heatmap_convalesence)
  
```


```{r volcano plot of Healthy vs Month 1-3, fig.width=5, fig.height=6}
table_convalesence <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%filter(Visit %in% c("Healthy", "Month 1-3")) %>%
  droplevels()

# Calculate p-values between Healthy and Month 1-3
     # Create the loop.vector (all the parameter columns)
    names(which(sapply(table_convalesence, is.numeric) == TRUE)) -> parameters 

  # Create table for stats
    table_convalesence_stat <- data.table (Parameter = numeric(), group1 = character(), 
                                              group2 = character(), n1 = numeric(),
                                              n2 = numeric(), statistic = numeric (),
                                              p = numeric (), p.signif = character(), FDR = numeric()) #FDR False Discovery Rate
   
  # Create loop for calculation of stat test by parameter between Healthy and Month 1-3
    for (i in parameters)
      
    { 
      # Formula to insert parameter in loop 
        formula = as.formula( paste(i, "Visit", sep="~") )
          
        stat_parameter <- table_convalesence %>% 
                          wilcox_test(formula = formula) %>%
                          add_significance() %>%
                          mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>% #Benjamini-Hochberg correction
                          rename(Parameter = .y.)
        
      # Combine currently calculated stats with previous calculations
        table_convalesence_stat <- rbind(table_convalesence_stat, stat_parameter)
    }

# Calculate FC between different Visits
    
      # Calculate Mean of parameters per group
        table_convalesence_log2  <- table_convalesence %>% 
                                       group_by(Visit) %>%
                                       summarise(across(CCL11:Grem2, ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))
      
      # Transverse Data Table and set rownames
        table_convalesence_log2_t  <- table_convalesence_log2  %>% 
                                         t %>% 
                                         as.data.frame() %>% 
                                         row_to_names(1)
     
     # Convert whole data table to numeric
       table_convalesence_log2_t  <- mutate_all(table_convalesence_log2_t, 
                                                   function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))
       
     # Calculate FC between Healthy and Month 1-3
       table_convalesence_log2_t$log2_fc <- log2(table_convalesence_log2_t$Healthy /
                                                    table_convalesence_log2_t$`Month 1-3`)
       
     # Add p-values to data table
        # Extract only Parameters and p-values
           stat.test_p <- table_convalesence_stat %>% 
                          dplyr::select(Parameter, FDR)

        # Merge data tables (log2, FC, p val)
          table_convalesence_log2_t$Parameter <- rownames(table_convalesence_log2_t)
          table_convalesence_volcano <- merge(table_convalesence_log2_t, stat.test_p, by = "Parameter")
 
  # Create Volcano Plot
          
     # Mark parameters if FC < -1.5 = downregulated
       table_convalesence_volcano$diff_expression <- ifelse(table_convalesence_volcano$log2_fc < -1.5, "down",
                                                            ifelse(table_convalesence_volcano$log2_fc > 1.5, "up", "no"))
     
     # Add new column to relabel parameters FC of <-1.5
      table_convalesence_volcano$label_para <- ifelse(table_convalesence_volcano$log2_fc < -1.5 |
                                                        table_convalesence_volcano$log2_fc > 1.5,
                                                      table_convalesence_volcano$Parameter, "")   
    
      volcano_convalescence <- EnhancedVolcano(table_convalesence_volcano, 
                                      lab = table_convalesence_volcano$label_para,
                                      x = 'log2_fc', y = 'FDR', 
                                      FCcutoff = 1.5, pointSize = 3.5, labSize = 4, colAlpha = 0.7,
                                      boxedLabels = TRUE, col = c("grey", "grey", "grey", "darkred"),   
                                      xlab = bquote(~Log[2]~ "fold change"), ylab = bquote("FDR-adjusted p-value (0.05)"),
                                      xlim = c(-3, 3), ylim = c(0, 10), pCutoff = 0.05,
                                      title = "Log2 fold change Month 1-3 vs Healthy", subtitle = NULL, border = 'full',
                                      drawConnectors = TRUE,widthConnectors = 0.5, colConnectors = "darkred") +
                                      theme_classic() +
                                      theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
                                            panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA,),
                                            legend.position = "none")
      
      print( volcano_convalescence)
```

```{r test rejection}

# Rename Convalescence vs Rejection
  table_rejection$ISHLT_2004 <- ifelse(table_rejection$ISHLT_2004 %in% c("ACR 2R", "ACR 3R"), "Rejection", "Convalescence")
```
